title: A Journal Of My Father
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume seinen drama by Jiro Taniguchi. Yoichi Yamashita returns to his hometown after more than a decade away for his father's funeral; as relatives share stories over drinks, he recalls the family barber shop, a fire that destroyed the family home, his parents' divorce and a stepmother, and comes to see the father he thought cold and absent in a new light (Ponent Mon blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates).
life_message: A life is understood through family memory, and estrangement can give way to late understanding and gratitude.
